title: Self-Ext homology as pushforward of a fixed Hom-complex
statement: For schemes Z and Y [def-pc-scheme], a closed immersion i:Z -> Y [def-weil-closed-immersion], and any supplied derived category on Y [def-pc-derived-category], let B=i_*O_Z and S be the degree-zero single functor. Let P on Y and J on Z be integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], with a K-flat resolution a:P -> B[0] [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] and a quasi-isomorphism b:O_Z[0] -> J [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], where J is K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Assume the tensor pullback functor i* [def-pc-module-pullback] is additive and put T=i*P termwise. For every integer k, there is an isomorphism H^k(RHom_Y(S(B),S(B))) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] with i_*H^k(Hom(T,J)) [def-pur-hom-complex]. It uses the actual supplied localization on Y and does not require a chosen derived category on Z in its statement.

source.place: Cohomology, Section 20.42 (08DH), tensor/internal-Hom adjunction (08DJ), the pullback evaluation mate (08I3), and Modules Lemma 17.13.4 (08KS). Representative and exact-pushforward part of step 2 of new-j3-self-ext-tor-core.

proof.text: Ordinary closed module pushforward preserves homology, and therefore termwise pushforward sends b to a quasi-isomorphism. Q(a) is invertible by the K-flat resolution hypothesis. Using singleMapHomologicalComplex, form isomorphisms Q(P) -> S(B) and S(B) -> Q(i_*J).

Apply RHom_Y to those two representative isomorphisms in its contravariant and covariant variables. Apply the general fixed K-flat/K-injective pushforward model, obtaining RHom_Y(S(B),S(B)) isomorphic to Q(i_*Hom(T,J)) in the actual supplied localization.

Apply degree-k derived homology. Compose with Mathlib derived homologyFunctorFactors at the actual pushed-forward Hom complex and ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso of ordinary closed pushforward at its degree-k short complex. This gives exactly the displayed ordinary pushforward of Hom-complex homology.

lean.statement: theorem nonempty_selfExt_pushforward_homology {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [IsClosedImmersion i] [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive] (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (J : CochainComplex Z.Modules ℤ) (a : P ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single Y.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))) (b : (HomologicalComplex.single Z.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf) ⟶ J) (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolution (R := Y.sheaf) a) (hb : QuasiIso b) (hJ : J.IsKInjective) (k : ℤ) : let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf) let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0 let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.sheaf let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P Nonempty (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))) ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj ((homComplex (R := Z.sheaf) T J).homology k))
